description: Polyphonic meta modulator with nine modes: a dual state variable filter, an ensemble chorus, four stereo reverbs, a frequency shifter, a bit crusher, a wave shaper, a panner, a delay and more

params.text: Blends between the algorithms of the mode in use, and sets the first filter's cutoff or the reverb's diffusion where the mode reads it that way; while MD is on it chooses the mode instead
Sets the shaping parameter of the mode in use: the second filter's cutoff, the chorus depth, or the reverb time, which freezes the Elements reverb at the far clockwise end
Cycles the internal oscillator through off and three waveforms; with the dual filter mode it picks which filter types the two outputs carry, and with the reverb mode which of the four reverbs runs
Sets the level of the signal at input 1; in the dual filter mode it sets the first filter's resonance, in the reverb mode the reverb amount or gain, and with the internal oscillator on its frequency
Sets the level of the signal at input 2; it sets the second filter's resonance in the dual filter mode, and the reverb's low-pass or feedback in the reverb mode
Hands the big knob over to choosing the module's mode, where it notches to the nine choices; switching it off returns the knob to the value it held
Switches the dual state variable filter mode to stereo; the other modes ignore it

inputs.text: Scales the first level knob, 5V giving the knob's own setting; with the internal oscillator on it sets that oscillator's pitch at one volt per octave. With nothing patched it reads 5V
Scales the second level knob, 5V giving the knob's own setting and more than that overdriving it; with nothing patched it reads 5V
Shifts the algorithm away from the one the big knob picks, 5V covering the whole sweep; it is ignored while the MD button is on
Adds to the TIMBRE knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
The carrier signal, which most of the modes filter or modulate so that it takes on the character of the other input; its channel count helps set the module's polyphony
The modulator signal, which most of the modes impose on the carrier; its channel count helps set the module's polyphony
Sets the mode for each polyphonic channel outright, overriding the knob: a whole volt per mode from 0V to 8V, or a semitone per mode from C4 upwards when the note reading is on

outputs.text: The main output, ±5V; it carries the left channel in the stereo modes and the first filter's output in the dual filter mode
The second output, ±5V; it carries the right channel in the stereo modes, the second filter's output in the dual filter mode, and the bare internal oscillator when that is on

notes: the module is polyphonic: the channel count comes from whichever of the two audio inputs carries more, and every channel runs its own copy of the modulator, with its own mode.
the two module channels are not the polyphonic channels: each polyphonic channel has a channel 1 and a channel 2 of its own, fed by the two audio inputs or by the internal oscillator.
the two level jacks read 5V when nothing is patched, which is full gain, so each level knob works on its own.
bypassing the module passes input 2 straight to the main output.
menu: Mode — picks the module's mode directly from the nine it carries, without the MD button; the entries run from Dual state variable filter to Meta mode
C4-G#4 direct mode selection — reads the MODE jack as note pitches from C4 upwards rather than as one whole volt per mode

inputs.0:
0 to 5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 5V, or 2V for the oscillator pitch; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 5V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
